public_events.text: The drawing resolves to a 24-tooth 08B driven sprocket: Ø99.93 tooth-tip envelope, R51.50 tooth-root envelope, Ø60 hub, Ø30 bore, 8 mm hub width, 7.21 mm toothed-plate width, and a 6 mm radial tapped hole. The dashed lines in the front view represent that radial bore through the hub, so I’ll model it as actual cut geometry, not linework.

Construction will be staged as separate native solids (toothed plate and hub), then unioned and checked before cutting the Ø30 bore, 8 mm keyway to the 33.3 mm over-bore dimension, and the radial M6 tapped-hole core. I’m also using layered tooth profiles to preserve the 1.65 mm edge relief shown in section A–A while keeping a single final solid.

arguments.lisp:
(vl-load-com)
(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
(setvar "INSUNITS" 4)

(defun ptstr (x y z)
  (strcat (rtos x 2 8) "," (rtos y 2 8) "," (rtos z 2 8)))

(defun sprocket-radius (q rtip / aq t)
  (setq aq (abs q))
  (cond
    ((<= aq 0.10) (- rtip (* 0.35 (/ (* aq aq) 0.01))))
    ((<= aq 0.28)
      (setq t (/ (- aq 0.10) 0.18))
      (- (- rtip 0.35) (* 2.25 t)))
    (T
      (setq t (/ (- aq 0.28) 0.22))
      (- (- rtip 2.60) (* (- rtip 47.00) (- (* 3.0 t t) (* 2.0 t t t)))))
  )
)

(defun make-profile (z rtip / n i pitch ang q r x y data)
  (setq n 384 i 0 pitch (/ (* 2.0 pi) 24.0) data nil)
  (repeat n
    (setq ang (* 2.0 pi (/ i n)))
    (setq q (- (/ (rem (+ ang (/ pitch 2.0)) pitch) pitch) 0.5))
    (setq r (sprocket-radius q rtip))
    (setq x (* r (cos ang)) y (* r (sin ang)))
    (setq data (append data (list (cons 10 (list x y)))))
    (setq i (1+ i))
  )
  (entmakex
    (append
      (list '(0 . "LWPOLYLINE") '(100 . "AcDbEntity") '(8 . "0")
            '(100 . "AcDbPolyline") (cons 90 n) '(70 . 1) (cons 38 z))
      data))
)

(defun make-tooth-layer (z h rtip / pl sol)
  (setq pl (make-profile z rtip))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" pl "" h)
  (setq sol (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nLAYER z=" (rtos z 2 3) " h=" (rtos h 2 3)
                 " tipR=" (rtos rtip 2 3)
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget sol)))))
  sol
)

(defun solid-count (/ ss)
  (setq ss (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
  (if ss (sslength ss) 0)
)

(defun main (/ layers s plate hub bore key rad ss final)
  (princ "\nOMNIMECH4_BUILD_BEGIN")

  ;; Axial edge relief: 1.65 mm on both faces, with four recoverable layers.
  (setq layers
    (list
      (make-tooth-layer 0.0 0.55 49.85)
      (make-tooth-layer 0.55 0.55 50.55)
      (make-tooth-layer 1.10 0.55 51.15)
      (make-tooth-layer 1.65 3.91 51.50)
      (make-tooth-layer 5.56 0.55 51.15)
      (make-tooth-layer 6.11 0.55 50.55)
      (make-tooth-layer 6.66 0.55 49.85)
    )
  )
  (setq ss (ssadd))
  (foreach s layers (ssadd s ss))
  (command "_.UNION" ss "")
  (setq plate (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_TOOTH_UNION count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget plate)))))

  ;; Hub: diameter 60, extending 8 mm from the plate's back face.
  (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,-8" "30" "8")
  (setq hub (entlast))
  (command "_.UNION" plate hub "")
  (setq final (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_HUB_UNION count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final)))))

  ;; Through bore diameter 30.
  (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,-8.5" "15" "16.21")
  (setq bore (entlast))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" final "" bore "")
  (setq final (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_BORE count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final)))))

  ;; 8 mm keyway; top is 18.3 from center, giving 33.3 over the opposite bore.
  (command "_.BOX" "-4,14.5,-8.5" "4,18.3,-8.5" "16.21")
  (setq key (entlast))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" final "" key "")
  (setq final (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_KEYWAY count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final)))))

  ;; M6 radial tapped hole represented by its 5 mm tapping core, centered in 8 mm hub.
  (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,0" "2.5" "18")
  (setq rad (entlast))
  (command "_.ROTATE3D" rad "" "_X" "0,0,0" "90")
  (command "_.MOVE" rad "" "0,0,0" "0,-14,-4")
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" final "" rad "")
  (setq final (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_M6 count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final)))))

  (if (and (= (solid-count) 1)
           (= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final))) "3DSOLID"))
    (progn
      (command "_.ZOOM" "_E")
      (princ "\nFINAL_VERIFICATION=PASS; SOLIDS=1; ENTITY=3DSOLID")
    )
    (princ "\nFINAL_VERIFICATION=FAIL")
  )
  (princ "\nOMNIMECH4_BUILD_END")
  (princ)
)
(main)

public_events.text: The reopen audit exposed a Core Console selection-set quirk: the DWG opened, but converting the `_X` selection result to an entity returned nil. I’m switching the audit to direct database traversal (`entnext`/DXF), which is the more reliable native check in headless AutoCAD and does not modify the candidate.

arguments.lisp:
(defun main (/ e cnt sol typ)
 (setq e (entnext) cnt 0 sol nil)
 (while e
  (setq typ (cdr (assoc 0 (entget e))))
  (if (= typ "3DSOLID") (progn (setq cnt (1+ cnt)) (setq sol e)))
  (setq e (entnext e)))
 (if (and (= cnt 1) sol (= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget sol))) "3DSOLID"))
  (princ "\nNATIVE_VERIFY=PASS;COUNT=1;TYPE=3DSOLID")
  (progn (princ (strcat "\nNATIVE_VERIFY=FAIL;COUNT=" (itoa cnt))) (exit)))
 (princ))
(main)

(defun sprocket-radius (q rtip / aq t)
  (setq aq (abs q))
  (cond
    ((<= aq 0.10) (- rtip (* 0.35 (/ (* aq aq) 0.01))))
    ((<= aq 0.28)
      (setq t (/ (- aq 0.10) 0.18))
      (- (- rtip 0.35) (* 2.25 t)))

      (- (- rtip 2.60) (* (- rtip 47.00) (- (* 3.0 t t) (* 2.0 t t t)))))
  )
)

(defun make-profile (z rtip / n i pitch ang q r x y data)
  (setq n 384 i 0 pitch (/ (* 2.0 pi) 24.0) data nil)
  (repeat n
    (setq ang (* 2.0 pi (/ i n)))
    (setq q (- (/ (rem (+ ang (/ pitch 2.0)) pitch) pitch) 0.5))
    (setq r (sprocket-radius q rtip))
    (setq x (* r (cos ang)) y (* r (sin ang)))
    (setq data (append data (list (cons 10 (list x y)))))
    (setq i (1+ i))
  )
  (entmakex
    (append

            '(100 . "AcDbPolyline") (cons 90 n) '(70 . 1) (cons 38 z))
      data))
)

  (command "_.EXTRUDE" pl "" h)
  (setq sol (entlast))

                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget sol)))))
  sol
)

  (if ss (sslength ss) 0)
)

  (princ "\nOMNIMECH4_BUILD_BEGIN")

  ;; Axial edge relief: 1.65 mm on both faces, with four recoverable layers.
  (setq layers
    (list
      (make-tooth-layer 0.0 0.55 49.85)
      (make-tooth-layer 0.55 0.55 50.55)
      (make-tooth-layer 1.10 0.55 51.15)
      (make-tooth-layer 1.65 3.91 51.50)
      (make-tooth-layer 5.56 0.55 51.15)
      (make-tooth-layer 6.11 0.55 50.55)
      (make-tooth-layer 6.66 0.55 49.85)
    )
  )
  (setq ss (ssadd))
  (foreach s layers (ssadd s ss))
  (command "_.UNION" ss "")
  (setq plate (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_TOOTH_UNION count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget plate)))))

  ;; Hub: diameter 60, extending 8 mm from the plate's back face.
  (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,-8" "30" "8")
  (setq hub (entlast))
  (command "_.UNION" plate hub "")
  (setq final (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_HUB_UNION count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final)))))

  ;; Through bore diameter 30.
  (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,-8.5" "15" "16.21")
  (setq bore (entlast))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" final "" bore "")
  (setq final (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_BORE count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final)))))

  ;; 8 mm keyway; top is 18.3 from center, giving 33.3 over the opposite bore.
  (command "_.BOX" "-4,14.5,-8.5" "4,18.3,-8.5" "16.21")
  (setq key (entlast))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" final "" key "")
  (setq final (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_KEYWAY count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final)))))

  ;; M6 radial tapped hole represented by its 5 mm tapping core, centered in 8 mm hub.
  (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,0" "2.5" "18")
  (setq rad (entlast))
  (command "_.ROTATE3D" rad "" "_X" "0,0,0" "90")
  (command "_.MOVE" rad "" "0,0,0" "0,-14,-4")
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" final "" rad "")
  (setq final (entlast))
  (princ (strcat "\nAFTER_M6 count=" (itoa (solid-count))
                 " type=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final)))))

  (if (and (= (solid-count) 1)
           (= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final))) "3DSOLID"))
    (progn
      (command "_.ZOOM" "_E")
      (princ "\nFINAL_VERIFICATION=PASS; SOLIDS=1; ENTITY=3DSOLID")
    )
    (princ "\nFINAL_VERIFICATION=FAIL")
  )
  (princ "\nOMNIMECH4_BUILD_END")
  (princ)
)
(main)

(defun tooth-poly (ang z delta / pitch offs full i aa rr raw data n)
 (setq pitch (/ (* 2.0 pi) 24.0)
  offs '(-0.245 -0.22 -0.20 -0.18 -0.16 -0.14 -0.12 -0.10 -0.08 -0.06 -0.04 -0.02
          0.02 0.04 0.06 0.08 0.10 0.12 0.14 0.16 0.18 0.20 0.22 0.245)
  full '(43.7 44.39 44.7 45.6 47.0 48.5 49.8 50.7 51.2 51.45 51.5 51.5
         51.5 51.5 51.45 51.2 50.7 49.8 48.5 47.0 45.6 44.7 44.39 43.7)
  i 0 data nil n (length offs))
 (repeat n
  (setq aa (+ ang (* (nth i offs) pitch)) raw (nth i full))
  (setq rr (if (<= raw 44.39) raw (max 44.39 (- raw delta))))
  (setq data (cons (cons 10 (list (* rr (cos aa)) (* rr (sin aa)))) data))
  (setq i (1+ i)))

(defun add-tooth-band (ang z h delta ss / p s)

 (if (/= (length s) 1)
  (progn (princ (strcat "\nFAIL_" tag "_COUNT=" (itoa (length s)))) (exit)))
 (princ (strcat "\nPASS_" tag "_COUNT=1"))
 (car s))

 (princ "\nA003_REPAIR_BEGIN")
 (if (setq old (ssget "_X")) (command "_.ERASE" old ""))

 (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,20.815" "44.39" "7.21")
 (setq root (entlast) ss (ssadd root) i 0)

 (repeat 24
  (setq ang (* (+ i 0.5) (/ (* 2.0 pi) 24.0)))

  ;; Back 1.65 relief: five overlapping 0.33-mm stages.

  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 21.145 0.34 1.155 ss))
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 21.475 0.34 0.825 ss))
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 21.805 0.34 0.495 ss))
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 22.135 0.33 0.165 ss))

  ;; Full-profile center band, 7.21 - 2(1.65) = 3.91.
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 22.455 3.930 0.0 ss))

  ;; Front 1.65 relief, mirrored.
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 26.375 0.34 0.165 ss))
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 26.705 0.34 0.495 ss))
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 27.035 0.34 0.825 ss))
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 27.365 0.34 1.155 ss))
  (setq ss (add-tooth-band ang 27.695 0.33 1.485 ss))

  (setq i (1+ i)))

 (command "_.UNION" ss "")
 (setq plate (req "CURVED_RELIEVED_TOOTH_PLATE"))

 ;; Preserve a002's correct diameter-60 hub and axial envelope.
 (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,0" "30" "20.865")
 (setq hub (entlast) ss (ssadd plate))
 (ssadd hub ss)(command "_.UNION" ss "")

 (setq cut (entlast))(command "_.SUBTRACT" final "" cut "")

 (command "_.CYLINDER" "0,0,0" "2.5" "18")
 (setq cut (entlast))
 (command "_.ROTATE3D" cut "" "_X" "0,0,0" "90")
 (command "_.MOVE" cut "" "0,0,0" "0,-14,8")
 (command "_.SUBTRACT" final "" cut "")

 (if (/= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final))) "3DSOLID")
  (progn (princ "\nFAIL_FINAL_TYPE") (exit)))
 (if (ssget "_X" '((0 . "TEXT,MTEXT,DIMENSION,LEADER,MULTILEADER")))
  (progn (princ "\nFAIL_ANNOTATIONS_PRESENT") (exit)))
 (command "_.ZOOM" "_E")
 (princ "\nEXPECTED_ENVELOPE=102.24,102.24,28.025")

 (princ "\nA003_REPAIR_END")(princ))
(main)

arguments.lisp:
(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
(command "_.UCS" "_W")
(defun bx (p l w h / e) (command "_.BOX" p "_L" l w h) (entlast))
(defun cy (p r h / e) (command "_.CYLINDER" p r h) (entlast))
(defun fr (p a b h / e) (command "_.CONE" p a "_T" b h) (entlast))
(defun typ (e) (if (and e (entget e)) (cdr (assoc 0 (entget e))) nil))
(defun un2 (a b / s)
 (setq s (ssadd)) (ssadd a s) (ssadd b s) (command "_.UNION" s "")
 (cond ((entget a) a) ((entget b) b) (T nil)))
(defun sub (a b / s1 s2)
 (setq s1 (ssadd) s2 (ssadd)) (ssadd a s1) (ssadd b s2)
 (command "_.SUBTRACT" s1 "" s2 "") a)
(defun nsol (/ s) (setq s (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID")))) (if s (sslength s) 0))
(defun fail (m) (princ (strcat "\nA005_ERROR: " m)) (quit))

; Replace a004 geometry with its end-band-refined form.
(setq all (ssget "_X"))
(if all (progn (setq i 0)
 (repeat (sslength all) (entdel (ssname all i)) (setq i (1+ i)))))

; Validated 40 x 7 x 4.8 rail and longitudinal side guide recesses.
(setq rail (bx '(-20.0 -3.5 0.0) 40.0 7.0 4.8))
(setq rail (sub rail (bx '(-20.1 3.1 2.2) 40.2 0.5 1.0)))
(setq rail (sub rail (bx '(-20.1 -3.6 2.2) 40.2 0.5 1.0)))
(if (/= (typ rail) "3DSOLID") (fail "rail profile"))

; M2 bores at exact 15 pitch and 5 end offsets.
; Transition reaches approximately radius 2.0 at the actual z=4.8 top.
(foreach x '(-15.0 0.0 15.0)
 (setq bore (cy (list x 0.0 -0.2) 1.0 5.2))
 (setq sink (fr (list x 0.0 3.8) 0.9 2.1 1.1))
 (setq cutter (un2 bore sink))
 (if (/= (typ cutter) "3DSOLID") (fail "countersink cutter"))
 (setq rail (sub rail cutter))
 (if (/= (typ rail) "3DSOLID") (fail "rail drilling"))
)

; Preserve a004 carriage envelope, full-width raised pad, clearance and jaws.
(setq body (bx '(-11.25 -8.5 1.9) 22.5 17.0 5.9))
(setq body (un2 body (bx '(-8.0 -8.5 7.7) 16.0 17.0 0.3)))
(setq body (sub body (bx '(-11.35 -3.6 1.8) 22.7 7.2 3.2)))
(setq body (un2 body (bx '(-11.25 2.9 3.3) 22.5 0.9 1.4)))
(setq body (un2 body (bx '(-11.25 -3.8 3.3) 22.5 0.9 1.4)))
(if (/= (typ body) "3DSOLID") (fail "body/guide structure"))

; Preserve shallow side shoulder reliefs.
(setq body (sub body (bx '(-8.0 8.3 3.2) 16.0 0.3 1.5)))
(setq body (sub body (bx '(-8.0 -8.6 3.2) 16.0 0.3 1.5)))

; Add narrow transverse end-band separation grooves at the 16 mm body boundaries.
; The lower carriage and rail remain continuous, so the result stays one solid.
(setq body (sub body (bx '(-8.09 -8.6 4.8) 0.18 17.2 3.4)))
(setq body (sub body (bx '(7.91 -8.6 4.8) 0.18 17.2 3.4)))
(if (/= (typ body) "3DSOLID") (fail "end-band grooves"))

; Exact 8 x 12 four-hole mounting pattern.
(foreach x '(-4.0 4.0)
 (foreach y '(-6.0 6.0)
  (setq body (sub body (cy (list x y 4.5) 1.0 3.8)))
  (if (/= (typ body) "3DSOLID") (fail "mounting holes"))
 )
)

(setq final (un2 rail body))
(if (or (/= (typ final) "3DSOLID") (/= (nsol) 1)) (fail "final union/count"))
(command "_.AUDIT" "_Y")
(command "_.REGENALL")
(if (/= (nsol) 1) (fail "post-audit count"))
(setq ss (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
(setq final (ssname ss 0))
(if (/= (typ final) "3DSOLID") (fail "final DXF type"))
(command "_.ZOOM" "_E")
(setq mn (getvar "EXTMIN") mx (getvar "EXTMAX"))
(setq dx (- (car mx) (car mn)) dy (- (cadr mx) (cadr mn)) dz (- (caddr mx) (caddr mn)))
(if (or (> (abs (- dx 40.0)) 0.1) (> (abs (- dy 17.0)) 0.1) (> (abs (- dz 8.0)) 0.1))
 (fail (strcat "cached extents " (rtos dx 2 4) "x" (rtos dy 2 4) "x" (rtos dz 2 4))))
(princ (strcat "\nA005_OK solid_count=1 type=" (typ final)
 " cached_extents=" (rtos dx 2 4) "x" (rtos dy 2 4) "x" (rtos dz 2 4)))
(princ)
